summary: [P1] W1b offers do_closeout.py --reinforce-episode as an option inside a running closeout — this reruns the entire flow, causing double episode append, double scope gate close, and double version bump.
evidence: In the manual /session-closeout checklist, choosing python3 scripts/do_closeout.py --reinforce-episode <ep-id> at W1b reruns the entire closeout flow, because that flag is handled by run_closeout() in scripts/do_closeout.py rather than by a W1b-only helper. If an operator follows this document after already completing W1, they will append a second episode, re-close the scope gate, and bump the patch twice. Applies to all 5 mirror files.
recommended_action: Either (a) remove the do_closeout.py path from the W1b block entirely and only offer reinforcement_count.py for the in-flow case, or (b) add an explicit guard: "Use do_closeout.py --reinforce-episode ONLY when running the entire closeout from scratch — not when W1 has already been executed in this flow."

summary: [P2] bootloader-state.md still advertises 0.1.2.22 / current_patch: 22 while azoth.yaml and roadmap.yaml have been bumped to 0.1.2.23.
evidence: After the W4 version bump, azoth.yaml and .azoth/roadmap.yaml move to 0.1.2.23 / current_patch: 23, but the W2 handoff record in .azoth/bootloader-state.md still shows 0.1.2.22 / current_patch: 22. Session-start instructions load bootloader-state.md as the authoritative state record, so the next session will see contradictory version metadata and may report or plan against the wrong patch number.
recommended_action: Update the version line in .azoth/bootloader-state.md from 0.1.2.22 to 0.1.2.23 and current_patch from 22 to 23 to match azoth.yaml and roadmap.yaml.
